{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-wv-class-e","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"a558279737f7816ae0b0ff945af2dbf704b24269461c1835add801947dd83750","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-wv-class-e:lineage:60","source_registry_sha256":"2261abaab8e2b1aaff5b8a336e3bfcf845adaa75847f0210442061783d7f9afb","source_liveness_sha256":"9a1fb68777f5e9d5c4b27899084cc233b265410fee506dfe6554447a61ea026e"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Defensive driving and weather","heading":"C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Defensive driving and weather","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Defensive driving and weather

FACT_ID: sec14-R01 | anchor: A01
The first flare goes about one vehicle length behind the disabled vehicle and the second about three hundred feet back, both on the shoulder beside the through lane [A01].
Why it matters: group breakdowns; difficulty medium; prereq sec14-F02; confusables sec14-F01, sec14-F02 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec14-R02 | anchor: A04
Partial hydroplaning begins at about thirty-five miles per hour, while at fifty-five miles per hour the tires ride entirely on the water and lose all contact in a severe rainstorm [A04].
Why it matters: group hydroplaning; difficulty high; prereq sec14-F21; confusables sec14-F21, sec14-F22 [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec14-R03 | anchor: A04
Six inches of water can float some smaller vehicles, whereas two feet of water will carry most vehicles away [A04].
Why it matters: group flooding; difficulty high; prereq sec14-F24; confusables sec14-F24, sec14-F25 [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec14-R04 | anchor: A04
Stopping on snow or ice can take up to twelve times the dry-pavement distance, and bridges and overpasses freeze while other pavement stays clear [A04].
Why it matters: group winter; difficulty medium; prereq sec14-F27; confusables sec14-F27 [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec14-R05 | anchor: A05
With anti-lock brakes you brake gently and keep steering, but without them you must pump the brakes to steer and release them the moment the wheels start to slip [A05].
Why it matters: group winter; difficulty high; prereq sec14-F29; confusables sec14-F29, sec14-F30 [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0074]

FACT_ID: sec14-R06 | anchor: A03
Headlight beams are dimmed within five hundred feet of an oncoming vehicle but within two hundred feet of a vehicle you are following [A03].
Why it matters: group light-conditions; difficulty high; prereq sec14-F18; confusables sec14-F18 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec14-R07 | anchor: A03
Over driving your headlights is a too-little-light problem of speed exceeding the lit distance, while sunrise and sunset glare is a too-much-light problem answered with the visor, sunglasses and lower speed [A03].
Why it matters: group light-conditions; difficulty medium; prereq sec14-F17; confusables sec14-F15, sec14-F17 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec14-R08 | anchor: A01
Turning around on an interstate means driving to the next exit, because a U-turn is never allowed there and the median crossovers belong to police and emergency vehicles [A01].
Why it matters: group interstate-habits; difficulty medium; prereq sec14-F05; confusables sec14-F05 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec14-R09 | anchor: A02
Pressure from vehicles behind and an empty cross street tempt the impatient driver merely to slow for a stop sign, yet a complete stop is required at every stop sign or red light even for a right turn [A02].
Why it matters: group driving-habits; difficulty medium; prereq sec14-F11; confusables sec14-F11, sec14-F10 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec14-R10 | anchor: A03
The impatient driver is simply in a hurry, whereas the arrogant or aggressive driver is purposely in a hurry and treats the vehicle as an extension of the ego [A03].
Why it matters: group driving-habits; difficulty low; prereq sec14-F13; confusables sec14-F11, sec14-F13 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec14-R11 | anchor: A05
In fog or dense smoke you drive on low beams with the wipers running, and if vision is impaired you pull off and stop with both the lights and the hazard flashers on [A05].
Why it matters: group fog; difficulty medium; prereq sec14-F32; confusables sec14-F32, sec14-F03 [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0074]

FACT_ID: sec14-R12 | anchor: A05
A state inspection is due every two years and its windshield sticker shows the month and year of the next one, and removing that sticker is against the law [A05].
Why it matters: group vehicle-condition; difficulty low; prereq sec14-F34; confusables sec14-F34 [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0074]
